dispute.claim_summary: The committed CaseWeave software delivery is the exact GitHub repository ometere123/caseweave at immutable commit 645208b7eaa2a1efdc2c296f784b26f89d7a635e. The claimant requests independent verification that this source revision and its changed-file membership match the agreed technical delivery obligation, with release of the funded milestone only if the verified source facts and acceptance criteria support that result.

dispute.response_summary: The developer submits a commit-pinned delivery record and requests independent assessment of the funded milestone.

verdict.fact_pattern_summary: The parties tied delivery to a specific GitHub repository artifact and acceptance criteria. Verified GitHub and source-adapter records confirm repository identity, immutable commit SHA, changed-file membership, CI success, and a live deployment. The respondent offered no stronger contrary evidence.
verdict.holding: When a freelance software agreement requires a commit-pinned, repository-authenticated artifact satisfying committed acceptance criteria, validators should treat independently verified repository identity, exact commit SHA, and authenticated changed-file membership as the primary proof of delivery; self-referential delivery notes are secondary, and CI/deployment evidence is corroborative unless the agreement expressly makes them mandatory acceptance conditions.
verdict.legal_issue: Whether the submitted GitHub commit constitutes the contractually required commit-pinned, repository-authenticated software artifact satisfying the agreed acceptance criteria.
verdict.reasoning_rule: For public-precedent freelance software disputes centered on commit-pinned delivery, the decisive inquiry is whether independent source verification confirms (1) the named repository identity, (2) the exact immutable commit, and (3) file membership or other source facts required by the acceptance criteria. If those facts are verified and align with the agreed criteria, delivery is satisfied absent verified evidence of a specific unmet contractual condition. Narrative evidence hosted in the repository may explain the delivery, but it does not outweigh authenticated repository metadata. CI and deployment checks support the finding but do not create extra obligations unless the agreement text expressly requires them.
verdict.short_reason: Verified source facts authenticate repo ometere123/caseweave at commit 645208b... and show changed files including app/lib/contract.ts, matching the committed delivery criteria. No contrary verified evidence defeats delivery.
